## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Market signals mixed — SPY (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising) and XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising) show equity strength while VXX (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -5.73%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND are muted, supporting a neutral read.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Tech-led momentum: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +31.89%) ABOVE TREND driving indices (QQQ (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND). Commodity tailwinds: CPER (1W: +7.15% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +18.79%) ABOVE TREND supporting cyclicals; bond softness: TLT (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -1.84%) BELOW TREND nudges SPY/TLT ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tightening tilt: HYG (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND show credit flat-to-weak, while VXX (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -5.73%) BELOW TREND indicates subdued fear; net is neutral financial conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leadership: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND; Energy strong: XLE (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +4.14%) ABOVE TREND. Defensives lag: XLU (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -2.43%) BELOW TREND and Utilities showing weakness.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperformance with broad internals: SPY (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ ABOVE TREND, while EEM (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +8.33%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.98%) ABOVE TREND show EM participation but less momentum than US tech.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation present but selective: IBIT (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +8.48%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +5.59%) ABOVE TREND indicate risk-on flows into crypto and small caps, while ARKK (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.68%) ABOVE TREND is flat.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity strength: CPER (1W: +7.15% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +16.65%) ABOVE TREND and BNO ABOVE TREND; metals mixed as GLD (1W: -1.04% | 1M: -3.01%) BELOW TREND while SLV (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +5.11%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy-biased market: XLE (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +4.14%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND — both showing strength and supporting cyclicals.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Technology and semiconductors (XLK, SOXX, QQQ) are ABOVE TREND across 1W and 1M. DIVERGENCE: Multiple sector ETFs in CORRECTION (XLY, IJR, SKYY, IGV) represent MINOR divergence — monitor for spillover but not yet a regime breaker.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposure: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +31.89%) ABOVE TREND and MTUM (1W: +4.54% | 1M: +13.80%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to defensives and gold: XLU (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -2.43%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -1.04% | 1M: -3.01%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology/semis (XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +31.89%) ABOVE TREND) and Energy (XLE (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +4.14%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Utilities (XLU (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -2.43%) BELOW TREND) and selected consumer discretionary names that are in CORRECTION (XLY (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil & industrial metals — BNO (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +18.79%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +7.15% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold and some precious metals — GLD (1W: -1.04% | 1M: -3.01%) BELOW TREND and PALL (1W: -2.86% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (watch credit health); XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot); SPY support around recent 1W dip zone implied by consolidation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and semiconductors showing the clearest strength (XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +31.89%) ABOVE TREND) with energy also contributing.  
Key risk is the cluster of CORRECTION divergences across cyclical ETFs (XLY (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION; SKYY (1W: -1.07% | 1M: +12.67%) CORRECTION) that could widen if leadership falters.
